Retrieves the list of lookalike domains for an organization based on the specified ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/lookalike-domains

Retrieves the list of lookalike domains for an organization based on the specified ID. To learn more, see About Lookalike Domains.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token
Responses
​
200
400
401
500

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
results
object[]
total_results
integer

The total number of lookalike domains present in the response
